text:
Jen Liu: Heads-up — found a broken link in the internal CLI quickstart (the mac/linux install section links to an old tarball on S3).
Sam O'Brien: ah, thanks for spotting. Which page path? can you paste the anchor?
Jen Liu: /docs/cli/quickstart.html#installing-on-mac-or-linux the link goes to s3://redwood-artifacts/cli/v0.8/old-cli.tar.gz and 404s in staging.
Anya Patel: @jen-liu good catch. I think we swapped artifact buckets during the deploy last month.
Jen Liu: quick idea to fix in-place: replace the href to /downloads/cli/latest/cli.tar.gz
Sam O'Brien: can you open a tiny PR? I can review. regex sed should do it if you want to patch across versions:
Jen Liu: here's the one-liner I used locally:
Jen Liu: ```
find content/docs/cli -type f -name "*.html" -exec sed -i 's|s3://redwood-artifacts/cli/v0.8/old-cli.tar.gz|/downloads/cli/latest/cli.tar.gz|g' {} +
```
Mike R: small nit — add a redirect in nginx for the old path? some external bookmarkers might still use the old URL.
Anya Patel: good call. I'll add an nginx redirect for the s3 key pattern and then we can land the docs PR. Can one of you paste the PR link once created?
Jen Liu: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1287 — small patch, updates link + adds a short note in the changelog.
Sam O'Brien: reviewing now. quick checklist: preview screenshot, run local hugo build, and update the broken-links CI ignore if it flags historical anchors.
docs-bot: Broken links scan (weekly): detected 1 occurrence in /docs/cli/quickstart.html -> flagged in PR #1287. Please ensure CI passes.
Sam O'Brien: merged and deployed to staging. @anja? (meant @Anya Patel) could you push the nginx redirect when you have 10m?
Anya Patel: redirect pushed to staging and prod. Confirmed 301 from the old s3 URL to /downloads/cli/latest/cli.tar.gz :thumbsup:
Jen Liu: awesome! thanks everyone. leaving the changelog note: "fix(cli): restore download link and add redirect for legacy S3 key"
Mike R: marking this as closed in the sprint board.
Sam O'Brien: thanks @Jen Liu for the patch and @Anya Patel for ops. :rocket:
